entities.summary: Peter Xu is the founder of an Evangelical Christian movement in China known as the "New Birth", "All Range", or "Born Again Movement." It is a Chinese house church movement, unregistered by the Chinese government. In 1997, he was sentenced to three years in prison for his leadership role. He moved to the United States following his release.
